evidence.scope: 35 checks passed with an owned diagnostic shader, including stored-float and keyword state checks, asynchronous ownership and complete drain. The installed game is unchanged. This does not validate the new fringe texture, original game shader or mesh streaming.

evidence.scope: Blender albedo review on the original Rock_3_Untitled and pole meshes, with retained UVs and material transforms. No native game shader claim.

evidence.scope: 512 RGBA candidate for straw_roof_alpha only. Mask derived from original project art; no copied game pixels or masks. UV, compressed mips, native shader and game checks pending. The smallest mips lose cutout coverage.

stage_definitions.approved: Explicit final approval recorded for the stated scope.
stage_definitions.authored: An authored replacement is explicitly mapped to this original asset.
stage_definitions.game_fixture_validated: Identified replacement or retained mesh participated in the cited game fixture.
stage_definitions.inventoried: Unique serialized original asset metadata recorded.
stage_definitions.native_validated: Identified authored replacement passed the cited native loading or sampling check.
stage_definitions.uv_reviewed: Authored appearance reviewed on identified original mesh UVs, within cited scope.

status_semantics: False means no matching completion evidence is recorded. Stages are independent and scoped; inventory is not visible replacement coverage.
